title: Personal Item Attachment
description: Canonical personal-item attachment record (Lap B, ruling loadout-lap-b-attachment-schema). Ingested from OggDude's itemattachments Type='Weapon'|'Armor'|'Gear' (203 + REPASSLIFT reclassified per R-LBS-7 = 204). Option C schema (R-LBS-1): structured first-class fields for resolver-readable stat modifiers + prose base_mods/added_mods for everything else. hp is null-honest (R-LBS-3 convention). Structured fields carry BASE values only (R-LBS-8); unlockable ranks live in added_mods with their rank count.

type.description: Which item registry this attachment targets. Lowercased from OggDude Type.

hp.description: Hard-point install cost; null = source lists none (R-LBS-3 null-honest). 62 of 327 source records lack HP; 12 of 18 Gear-type lack it.

is_crystal.description: True for lightsaber crystals (21 source records). Flag only — no crystal behaviour shipped (R-LBS-4 scope fence).

encumbrance_threshold_bonus.description: BASE bonus to encumbrance threshold from this attachment when installed (R-LBS-8). null = does not modify. Unlockable additional ranks live in added_mods. Read by computeEncumbrance via R-LAB-7.

damage_mod.description: Additive damage modifier. Positive = increase. null = does not modify. Source keys: DAMADD (+), DAMSUB (-).

crit_mod.description: Relative critical rating modifier. Negative = easier to crit (CRITSUB). null = does not modify. R-LBS-2: separate from crit_set.

crit_set.description: Absolute critical rating override (CRITSET). null = does not override. R-LBS-2: a flag that changes the meaning of a neighbouring number is the shape that produces silent wrong maths.

damage_set.description: Absolute damage override (DAMSET). null = does not override. Mirrors crit_set pattern. 23 lightsaber crystals. DATA ONLY — not wired to the resolver in this lap (C-IES-1).

range_mod.description: Range band delta (RANGEADD +1, RANGESUB -1). null = does not modify. DATA ONLY — not wired to the resolver in this lap.

soak_mod.description: Additive soak modifier. Source keys: ARMORADD. null = does not modify.

defense_melee_mod.description: Additive melee defense modifier. Source keys: MELEEDEFADD, DEFENSIVE. null = does not modify.

defense_ranged_mod.description: Additive ranged defense modifier. Source keys: RANGEDEFADD, DEFADD. null = does not modify.

encumbrance_mod.description: Additive encumbrance modifier on the parent item. Negative = lighter (ENCSUB). null = does not modify.

qualities_add.description: Weapon/armor qualities added by this attachment (BaseMods only). Source keys: PIERCE, VICIOUS, STUN, BURN, etc.

qualities_remove.description: Weapon/armor qualities removed by this attachment. Source keys: REMQUALSTUNSETTING, REMQUALBREACH, etc.

character_effects.description: F-100 M12 MV3 (f100-m12-census-card R-M12C-55/-95; gate table f100-m12-gate-table §2): a BASE line's talent effect op, held while the character USES the modded item (EotE p.187: 'as if he had +1 rank … when using the modded item'). The base line carries the same op as its `effect` (type item_character_effect), the QR1 precedent. Newly MODELLED (R-M12F-8).

host_hard_points_delta.description: F-100 M12 MV4 (f100-m12-census-card R-M12C-55/-95): a BASE line that changes its HOST's available hard points (Component Alteration, Concealment Alteration: -1, once per item, permanent), the attachment-side sibling of a talent item_effect's hard_points_delta, read by pcHardpointAccounting. The base line carries it as its `effect` (type host_hard_points_delta). Newly MODELLED (R-M12F-8).

key.description: Canonical quality id whose RATING is lowered (e.g. 'cumbersome').

by.description: How far the rating drops (EotE p.193: 'Decrease Cumbersome rating by 2').

floor.description: OPTIONAL: the lowest rating this row leaves (default 0: at 0 the quality is gone). A rating at or below it is never raised.

condition.description: OPTIONAL: the page's own words for WHEN the reduction holds (the bipod's 'when firing from a prone or crouched position (or can otherwise brace the bipod on something)', EotE p.188). A row with a condition is never applied: it is OFFERED (SWRPGQualityRows.poolRows, via the resolved record's _qualityOffers).

cite.description: The printing the row stands on: book id + PRINTED page (R-RRD-1).

qualities_reduce.description: F-100 M12 QR1 (f100-m12-build-card R-M12B-8 B-1204; census card R-M12C-9/-53 + erratum, admitted R-M12C-95): BASE reductions of a quality's RATING on the host weapon, applied by ItemResolve.applyInstalledAttachments after this attachment's qualities_add. LIVE. Written ONLY by scripts/canonical/apply_m12_attachment_corrections.py (page-cited); personal_attachments.py emits {key, by} from OggDude's negative-count and SUBQUAL* keys (the cause of B-1204, fixed).

allOf.description: F-100 M12 R-M12B-63 (f100-m12-build-card ADDENDUM 20): `condition` is EXPLICIT on an attachment row — null only where the line's words carry none, else its words. Presence is the fact; an absent key is not a recorded fact, and would auto-apply by accident once R1 carries the row.

pool_mods.description: Extracted dice-pool modifiers at row level (R-DPS-1). Each entry traces back to its source mod object via from. F-100 M12 (f100-m12-census-card R-M12C-55/-95/-98, the reader gap R1): CARRIED onto the host by applyInstalledAttachments (base rows always; a row whose `from.channel` is added_mods only while that option is selected), newly MODELLED (R-M12F-8). An attachment row takes the refusal wrapper's FIRST arm only, as a quality row does (R-B219C-17): it refuses a difficulty upgrade but ADMITS `symbol: threat`, which lands on the OWNER's own check (Galven pattern resequencing, "Adds automatic [TH][TH] to all combat checks made using this weapon", Forged in Battle p.51; R-M12C-98). `applies_to {scope: host_item}` (MV1) is admitted here and nowhere else.

weapon_profile.description: Secondary weapon profile granted by this attachment (R-LBS-5). 12 in-scope rows. A profile, not a second weapons registry — display + resolve data, never looked up by id.

damage_base.description: Present when the profile uses Brawn+value (DamageAdd, melee). Absent = flat damage.

constraints.description: RAW install limits — which items can take this attachment. ACROSS kinds: AND (every kind present must pass). WITHIN a kind's array: OR. An item lacking the matched field sends that kind to `unevaluated`, never to `reasons` — flagged, not scored (C-LBA-1).

category_limit.description: Item categories the attachment may install on. OR within the array.

item_limit.description: Named models only, by OggDude source key. OR within the array.

skill_limit.description: CANONICAL skill ids (ranged_heavy, melee, ...) matched against the item's resolved `skill`. NEVER raw OggDude keys (RANGHVY): the registries hold snake_case ids, so an untranslated key matches nothing and the constraint fails open — silence wearing a constraint's clothes. The importer translates via skills.vocab.json aliases. OR within the array. (R-ACV-2)

type_limit.description: OggDude Type-taxonomy strings (Melee, Energy Weapon, Slugthrower, ...) matched EXACTLY against the item's own `type`. A different axis from category_limit; the two coexist. OR within the array. (R-ACV-2)

stat_limit.description: Numeric thresholds on the item's PRINTED profile. Keys are a CLOSED vocabulary — soak, defense, encumbrance — being the canonical record's own field names; an unknown key is a HARD validator failure, because a typo would silently unevaluate and fail open forever. Bounds are inclusive integers, at least one of min/max. Multiple keys AND. There is NO OR grammar: canonical armor carries one `defense` field, so "melee or ranged defense 1+" is just {defense:{min:1}}. Evaluated against the BASE record, never the resolved-with-attachments shape — eligibility that moved with installed attachments would make install ORDER change what fits. (R-ANE-1/2)

universal.description: REVIEWED marker: a human read this attachment and found it genuinely fits anything of its type. Distinct from silence — an attachment with neither `constraints` nor `universal: true` has never been assessed, and the validator fails on it. Never set by inference. (B-252)

constraints_wording.description: How this record's `constraints` were arrived at. `verified` — the source states the rule outright (an OggDude structured field, or an unambiguous sentence a human read). `inferred` — a human read prose that IMPLIES the rule without stating it. Required whenever `constraints` is present, so a reader can tell a transcribed rule from a judged one without re-deriving either. (R-ACV-2 / B-252)

universal_wording.description: How `universal: true` was arrived at. `verified` — the description says so outright ('can be applied to any armor'). `inferred` — no restriction is stated anywhere, or the only limit is one the book leaves to the table ('any armor that could logically...'). Required with `universal`, for the same reason `constraints_wording` is required with `constraints`: a reviewed finding and a transcribed one must be tellable apart. (B-252)
